question: Как безопасно убрать весь baggage перед передачей контекста недоверенному процессу и как при этом приложение должно взаимодействовать с Context, если он распространяется неявно?
facts: specification/baggage/api.md#Clear Baggage in the Context

To avoid sending any name/value pairs to an untrusted process, the Baggage API
MUST provide a way to remove all baggage entries from a context.
specification/baggage/api.md#Context Interaction

API users SHOULD NOT have
access to the [Context Key](../context/README.md#create-a-key) used by the
Baggage API implementation.
specification/context/README.md#Optional Global operations

These operations are expected to only be implemented by languages
using `Context` implicitly, and thus are optional.
specification/context/README.md#Attach Context

Note that every call to this operation should result in a corresponding call to
[Detach Context](#detach-context).
specification/context/README.md#Detach Context
A `Token` that was returned by a previous call to attach a `Context`.
specification/context/README.md#Overview

Users writing instrumentation in languages that use `Context` implicitly are
discouraged from using the `Context` API directly.

question: Что должен делать TextMap Extract с непарсируемым значением и как HTTP Getter обрабатывает отсутствующий ключ, регистр и несколько значений одного ключа?
facts: specification/context/api-propagators.md#Extract

the implementation MUST NOT throw an exception and MUST NOT store a new value in the `Context`,
in order to preserve any previously existing valid value.
specification/context/api-propagators.md#Get
The Get function MUST return the first value of the given propagation key or return null if the key doesn't exist.
specification/context/api-propagators.md#Get
If the getter is intended to work with an HTTP request object, the getter MUST be case insensitive.
specification/context/api-propagators.md#GetAll
If explicitly implemented, the `GetAll` function MUST return all values of the given propagation key.
specification/context/api-propagators.md#GetAll
If the key doesn't exist, it SHOULD return an empty collection.
